exam: 109年公務人員高等考試一級暨二級考試
subject: 英文

essays.text: 英譯中：（30分）Backaches, which lame an estimated 5.4 million Americans each year, haveresisted all medical miracles. A leading treatment for recurring low back painis still the sofa, upon which a patient is supposed to recline, usually for at leasta week and often much longer, until the pain goes away. Lingering backacheskeep more workers off the job than any other ailment, costing the nation $16billion in medical bills and lost wages annually. But it now appears that youshouldn’t take a bad back lying down. Medical researchers in Sweden haveshown that the best remedy for the most common type of backache is exercise,and that the afflicted should be active even if it hurts.
中譯英：（30分）模擬遊戲中的角色扮演可能會扭曲玩家對現實的觀感。比方說，遊戲中玩家可能重複被對手刺死或是未能引爆炸彈而任務失敗，但在網絡空間，那不會造成問題，因為玩家可以隨心所欲地將遊戲倒帶，一直重玩遊戲中的事件直到他們採取了正確的行動，他們可能因此與現實脫節。

英文作文：（40分）While some suggest that parents should be legally punished for the poorparenting causing their children’s delinquent behavior, some are against thisidea. Write an essay in English of NO more than 300 words to explain whetheryou agree or disagree to this idea with arguments for both sides.
